item.title: Marketing Page
item.description:
TuanPets: Record Pet Life More Easily With Your Family

TuanPets is a record-keeping and collaboration app built for pet households. It makes daily logging faster and shared care simpler.

Highlights

1. Quick Records

  • Open the app and log care events without a complicated workflow
  • Record feeding, medication, weight, mood, health notes, and routine changes
  • Turn scattered details into a continuous pet care history you can revisit

2. Shared Care

  • Let family members, partners, or housemates maintain records for the same pet
  • Keep information in sync so everyone knows what has already been done
  • Make important care items visible and reduce missed or duplicated tasks

3. Simple Interface

  • Get started quickly, even on first use
  • Keep key information clear without unrelated distractions
  • Focus on frequent daily care scenarios and reduce operational friction

Who It Is For

  • Pet families that want everyone to stay aligned on daily care
  • Two-person or shared caregiving situations that need fewer reminders and less back-and-forth
  • New pet owners who want a simple way to build a consistent care record habit

What We Care About

TuanPets does not try to be complicated. It focuses on making the most common and important records and collaboration flows feel natural, lightweight, and reliable.

item.title: 营销页面
item.description:
团宠：和家人一起，把宠物生活记录得更轻松

团宠是一款专注宠物家庭场景的记录与协作工具。它让“记下来”这件事变得更快，也让“共同照护”这件事变得更简单。

核心亮点

1) 快速记录

  • 打开就能记，不需要复杂步骤
  • 支持随手记录喂食、用药、体重、状态变化
  • 让零碎信息变成连续、可回顾的宠物成长轨迹

2) 多人协作

  • 家人、伴侣、同住室友可共同维护同一只宠物的记录
  • 信息实时同步，避免“我以为你喂过了”的重复操作
  • 关键事项清晰可见，照护分工更顺畅

3) 界面简洁

  • 没有复杂学习成本，首次使用也能快速上手
  • 重点信息一目了然，不被无关功能干扰
  • 以日常高频场景为中心，减少操作负担

适合谁使用

  • 养宠家庭：希望全家同步宠物日常信息
  • 双人照护：希望减少沟通成本和遗漏
  • 宠物新手：希望用简单方式建立稳定记录习惯

我们希望带来的价值

团宠不追求复杂，而是把最常用、最关键的记录和协作体验做好。
你负责好好陪伴，我们负责把记录与协同变得自然、轻量、可靠。

item.title: Privacy Policy
item.description:
TuanPets Privacy Policy

Effective Date: 2026-04-09

Welcome to TuanPets (the “App”). We care about your privacy and data security. This Privacy Policy explains how we handle your information.

1. We Do Not Collect Personal Data

The App does not collect, sell, or share personally identifiable data, including but not limited to:

  • Name, phone number, or email address
  • Precise location information
  • Contacts or photos, except content you actively create and save in the App
  • Advertising identifiers or cross-app tracking data

We do not use your data for advertising, user profiling, or third-party marketing.

2. How Data Is Stored

Business data that you actively create in the App, such as pet profiles, daily records, and shared care notes, is used only to provide the App’s core features. This data is stored in your iCloud environment through Apple CloudKit.

  • Cloud storage is provided by Apple CloudKit
  • We do not maintain our own user behavior data warehouse
  • We do not sync your data to third-party servers outside the Apple platform

3. Shared Care

When you actively share records or invite collaborators, you authorize the related records to be visible to invited members so collaboration features can work. Outside the collaborator relationship you choose, we do not disclose your content data.

4. Data Security

We take reasonable product and engineering measures to reduce the risk of unauthorized access, disclosure, or misuse. You should also protect your Apple account and device access.

5. Children’s Privacy

The App is not intended to be used independently by children under the age of 14. If a guardian finds that a minor has submitted inappropriate information without consent, please contact us so we can help address it.

6. Your Rights and Choices

You can manage your data at any time by:

  • Editing or deleting content you created in the App
  • Managing sync behavior through iCloud or CloudKit settings
  • Stopping use of the App

7. Updates to This Policy

If we make material changes to this Privacy Policy, we will notify you through in-app prompts or page updates. The updated version takes effect from the date it is published.

8. Contact Us

If you have questions or suggestions about this Privacy Policy, please contact us through the contact method provided on the App’s release page.

item.title: 隐私协议
item.description:
团宠隐私协议

生效日期：2026-04-09

欢迎使用团宠（以下简称“本应用”）。我们非常重视你的隐私与数据安全。本隐私协议用于说明我们如何处理你的信息。

1. 我们不采集个人数据

本应用不采集、不出售、不共享任何可识别个人身份的数据，包括但不限于：

  • 姓名、手机号、邮箱地址
  • 精确位置信息
  • 通讯录、照片（除你主动在应用内创建并保存的内容）
  • 设备广告标识符或跨应用追踪数据

我们不会将你的数据用于广告投放、用户画像或第三方营销。

2. 数据存储方式

你在本应用中主动创建的业务数据（例如宠物档案、日常记录、协作备注等）仅用于实现应用核心功能，并通过 Apple CloudKit 存储在你的 iCloud 环境中。

  • 数据由 Apple CloudKit 提供云端存储能力
  • 我们不自建用户行为数据仓库
  • 我们不将数据同步到非 Apple 平台的第三方服务器

3. 多人协作说明

当你主动发起共享或邀请协作者时，你授权相关记录在被邀请成员之间可见，以实现协作功能。除协作者关系范围外，我们不会额外披露你的内容数据。

4. 数据安全

我们采取合理的产品与工程措施，降低数据未经授权访问、泄露或误用的风险。你也应妥善保管自己的 Apple 账户与设备访问权限。

5. 未成年人隐私

本应用不面向未满 14 周岁儿童单独提供服务。若监护人发现未成年人在未经同意情况下提交了不当信息，请联系我们处理。

6. 权利与选择

你可以随时通过以下方式管理数据：

  • 在应用内修改或删除你创建的内容
  • 通过 iCloud / CloudKit 相关设置管理同步行为
  • 停止使用本应用

7. 协议更新

当本隐私协议发生重大变更时，我们会通过应用内提示或页面更新方式通知你。更新后的版本自发布之日起生效。

8. 联系我们

如你对本隐私协议有疑问或建议，请通过应用发布页提供的联系方式与我们联系。
